intent: PRIMARY: Holographic stickers quantity input; role=spinbutton; text="Quantity of Holographic stickers" | HINTS: cart line for Holographic stickers
rationale: Set the Holographic stickers cart quantity to the requested value.

action_instruction: Reading the Holographic stickers quantity from the cart line
intent: the quantity shown for the Holographic stickers cart line

action_params.condition: The Holographic stickers cart line shows quantity 2.
action_params.query: the quantity shown for the Holographic stickers cart line

action_instruction: Reading the Holographic stickers line price from the cart
intent: the line price shown for the Holographic stickers cart line

action_params.condition: The Holographic stickers cart line shows line price $18.00.
action_params.query: the line price shown for the Holographic stickers cart line

action_instruction: Reading the merchandise subtotal from the cart summary
intent: the merchandise subtotal shown in the cart summary

action_params.query: the merchandise subtotal shown in the cart summary

action_instruction: Comparing the merchandise subtotal with the displayed line-price sum
intent: the difference between the merchandise subtotal and the displayed cart line prices

action_params.condition: The merchandise subtotal $58.00 equals the displayed sum of line prices.
action_params.query: the difference between the merchandise subtotal and the displayed cart line prices
action_params.code_js: (() => { const subtotal = parseFloat((el(14).querySelector('[data-testid="cart-subtotal"]')?.textContent ?? '').replace(/[^\d.]/g, '')); const total = [...el(14).querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="cart-line-"] b')].reduce((sum, price) => sum + parseFloat(price.textContent.replace(/[^\d.]/g, '')), 0); return subtotal - total; })()

action_instruction: Checking whether free shipping is unlocked
intent: whether free shipping unlocked is present (in the cart summary)

action_params.query: whether free shipping unlocked is present (in the cart summary)
locators: internal:text="You've unlocked free shipping.Subtotal$58.00Promo codes and shipping are"i

assertion_tree.description: the line now shows quantity 2 with line price $18.00, the merchandise subtotal is $58.00 which equals the displayed sum of line prices, and the cart shows that free shipping has been unlocked.

sub_results.description: The Holographic stickers cart line shows quantity 2.
The Holographic stickers cart line shows line price $18.00.
The merchandise subtotal $58.00 equals the displayed sum of line prices.

assertion_tree.verification: The Holographic stickers cart line, merchandise subtotal, displayed sum of line prices, and shipping status.
